hooks.command: grep -q 'git push' || exit 0; git diff --name-only "$(git rev-parse -q --verify '@{push}' 2>/dev/null || echo origin/main)" HEAD -- docs/specs docs/adr .specful 2>/dev/null | grep -q . || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Outgoing commits change Specful artifacts. Before pushing, run the specful-review skill as a change review of the commits not yet on the remote, and do not push on a NO-SHIP verdict."}}'
grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; specful index --check >&2 && specful validate >&2 || exit 2
